name: Zivar
summary: Zivar carries a body finished in brass metallic paint, giving it a warm, radiant presence with a subtle sheen. The interior and base in matte black add a deep, refined contrast that sharpens the silhouette. The combination delivers a modern piece with a composed, upscale character. Body with brass metallic paint, inside and base in matt black 70×100 / 60x60x100 / 75x75x60
